title: Witness drawings of colored lights on lined paper, captioned "Drawings"
description: Two scanned pen sketches on ruled notebook paper, separated by the caption "Drawings." The upper sheet shows several oval shapes filled with circles and squiggles, annotated "Reddish orange," "steel white lines," "Spinning fast" and "Always changing shape and color." The lower sheet depicts a stacked cluster of circles labeled with colors "Silver Green Blue Orange Red Flashing," a note that they "went out to look like others on other side," a "7 total" label, and a small figure on the ground.
